collection.description: A hammock woven over several generations needs repair, and each age group believes it should decide what happens.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A hammock woven over several generations needs repair, and each age group believes it should decide what happens.

choices.label: Ask Children What the Hammock Means to Them
Ask Teenagers to Assess the Repairs
Ask Adults About Safety and Materials

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They explain that it is the place where their favorite stories are told.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They suggest keeping a small piece of the old weaving as a memory.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: They propose a practical reinforcement with adult inspection.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Their trial weave is uncomfortable, so they redesign it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They replace worn supports and make the hammock safe again.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The damage is too severe for safe use, and they recommend retiring it.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) recalls the hands that first made it and supports a careful restoration.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (elder) surprises everyone by saying that making a new hammock can honor the old one.
